title: Migrate decision loop source root
summary: Move decision/table/compiler ownership from `src/change/**` toward target `src/decision/**` without shim-only roots.

goal.outcome: Decision loop source ownership uses `src/decision/**` for decision tables/compiler/tool/gate responsibilities while preserving public API behavior.
acceptance: Decision/table/compiler files are moved or introduced under `src/decision/**` with imports updated.
`src/change/**` is removed or reduced to documented previous-state compatibility only with trigger.
File-structure audit no longer reports decision-loop source-root mismatch for this slice.
non_goals: Do not migrate planning, implementation, graph, Pi, or runtime roots here.
Do not change decision semantics beyond import/path migration.

delta.desired: Additional outcome: Planning loop source ownership uses `src/planning/**` for work shaping, roadmap mutation, and planning tool responsibilities while preserving roadmap behavior.
